agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, July 22, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting held on July 8, 2015
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2015-37 Approving the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Award of a Professional Services Agreement with Martin & Chapman for election services in an amount not to exceed $38,290.
ACTION: To approve of a Professional Services Agreement with Martin & Chapman to provide election services for the November 3, 2015, General Municipal Election in an amount not to exceed $38,290.
Item #7d
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
9.
DISCUSSION/CONSIDERATION ADOPTING A RESOLUTION FINDING THE CITY IN CONFORMANCE WITH THE CONGESTION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM (CMP)
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
Res. 2015-39 - A Resolution of the City of Lomita, California, finding the City to be in conformance with the Congestion Management Program (CMP) and adopting the CMP Local Development Report, in accordance with California Government Code Section 65089.
ACTION: An annual review of the City of Lomita's conformance with the Congestion Management Program (CMP) for Los Angeles County, and adoption of a resolution finding the City in conformance with the Congestion Management Program and adopting the CMP Local Development Report (LDR).
Item#9
10.
PUBLIC HEARING TO DISCUSS APPROVAL OF A YOUTH EMPLOYMENT PLAN FOR THE REGIONAL PARK AND OPEN SPACE DISTRICT SPECIFIED PROJECT GRANT PROGRAM FOR THE GYMNASIUM AND COMMUNITY BUILDING UPGRADE PROJECT
Presented by Parks & Recreation Director Harding
Res. 2015-40 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, approving the adoption of a Youth Employment Plan for the Regional Park and Open Space District Specified Project Grant Program for the Gymnasium and Community Building Upgrade Project.
ACTION: Adopt a resolution approving the Youth Employment Plan for the Regional Park and Open Space District Specified Project Grant Program for the Lomita Park Gymnasium and Community Building Upgrade Project.
Item #10
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
11.
CONSIDER AWARD OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT TO HAZEN AND SAWYER ENGINEERS AND SCIENTISTS IN THE AMOUNT OF $158,850 TO PREPARE PLANS, SPECIFICATIONS, AND ESTIMATES FOR THE CYPRESS WATER PRODUCTION FACILITY UPGRADES AND ZONE 2 CONNECTION PROJECTS
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
ACTIONS:
a.
Authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Hazen and Sawyer Engineers and Scientists in the amount of $158,850 for preparation of Plans, Specifications, and Estimates (PS&E) for the Cypress Water Production Facility and Zone 2 Connection Project; and
b.
Approve a total budget of $174,735 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen scope/conditions).
Item #11
12.
CONSIDER APPOINTMENT OF (1) PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSIONER AND (1) PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC COMMISSIONER
Presented by City Manager Rock
ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council appoint Tommy Bonham to the Parks & Recreation Commission to a term that will end January 2016, and appoint Jim Thompson to the Public Safety and Traffic Commission to a term that will end June 2019. Both seats are available due to resignations.
Item #12
8.
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE REGARDING ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 2015-02 (THRIFT STORES) AND COORDINATED REVIEW OF CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 296 TO ALLOW A NEW 7,743 SQUARE FOOT THRIFT STORE LOCATED AT 2308 AND 2310 PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
Ord. 775 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Zone Text Amendment No. 2015-02, an amendment to Section 11-1.68.08 (Thrift Stores) of the Lomita Municipal Code to provide the Planning Commission the ability to modify the 1,000 foot distance requirement between Thrift Store facilities, with certain findings and conditions. (Filed by Cherine Medawar, 3001 Crownview Drive, Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275.)
Res. 2015-38 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, approving Conditional Use Permit No. 296 to permit a new 7,742 square foot Thrift Store located at 2308 and 2310 Pacific Coast Highway in the C-R, Commercial Retail Zone. (Filed by Cherine Medawar, 3001 Crownview Drive, Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275.)
1.
Approve first reading of an ordinance amending Lomita Municipal Code Section 11-1.68.08 (Thrift Stores) to allow the Planning Commission to amend the distance requirement between thrift stores subject to certain findings; and
2.
Adopt a resolution approving Conditional Use Permit No 296 to allow a new 7,743 square foot thrift store located at 2308 and 2310 Pacific Coast Highway.
Item #8
8.
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE REGARDING ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 2015-02 (THRIFT STORES) AND COORDINATED REVIEW OF CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 296 TO ALLOW A NEW 7,743 SQUARE FOOT THRIFT STORE LOCATED AT 2308 AND 2310 PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
Ord. 775 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Zone Text Amendment No. 2015-02, an amendment to Section 11-1.68.08 (Thrift Stores) of the Lomita Municipal Code to provide the Planning Commission the ability to modify the 1,000 foot distance requirement between Thrift Store facilities, with certain findings and conditions. (Filed by Cherine Medawar, 3001 Crownview Drive, Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275.)
Res. 2015-38 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, approving Conditional Use Permit No. 296 to permit a new 7,742 square foot Thrift Store located at 2308 and 2310 Pacific Coast Highway in the C-R, Commercial Retail Zone. (Filed by Cherine Medawar, 3001 Crownview Drive, Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275.)
13.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on August 12, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
